in_english.name: Calista
in_english.long_meaning: Calista is a Christian name with Hebrew origin, derived from the word kal, meaning 'beauty' or 'loveliness.' It is found in the New Testament in 1 Peter 3:3-4, where it is used to describe the inner beauty of a woman. In Christian tradition, Calista symbolizes the beauty of a virtuous life and the importance of inner beauty over external physical appearance. It is also associated with the virtues of kindness, compassion, and humility. As a given name, Calista has been popular in various Christian cultures, including Greek and Latin American communities.
